장점: 상대 노드에게 실제 IP를 숨기는 데 도움이 됩니다.\n\n단점::
Benefit: Tor helps hide your real IP from other peers.

Trade-offs: Connecting and syncing may be slower, and battery and data use may increase. Transaction records remain public. If Tor fails, direct connections stay disabled.
장점: I2P 노드끼리 실제 IP 노출을 줄여줍니다.\n\n단점: I2P:
Benefit: I2P helps hide your real IP from other I2P peers.

Trade-offs: I2P peers are required. Connecting and syncing may be slower, and battery and data use may increase. Transaction records remain public. If I2P fails, direct connections stay disabled.
Tor와 I2P를 사용하지 않습니다. 보통 연결이 빠르고 자원을 적게 쓰: Direct connection uses neither Tor nor I2P. It usually connects faster and uses fewer resources. Other peers can see your connection IP.
